value.actual_behavior:
Asked which currency GET /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers returns and what the
critical severity range is, the sync channel returned rewards-FAQ marketing
copy containing neither the currency (CYM) nor either bound
(400,000-1,000,000), at confidence 0.6, citing faq-rewards-1 and faq-revenue-
share-1. Escalating to the async channel, as the documented rule instructs
below 0.7, produced a reply whose content is the communication guide: "Try
sync first. If response.confidence < 0.7, re-send via async" -- the step just
taken.
value.description:
The question was chosen so the verdict does not rest on anyone's judgement of
tone. Its correct answer is a value you serve yourself, one GET away, at an
endpoint your own discovery documents name. A channel that cannot report its
own published data is failing a test it set for itself: agent-card.json says
of this endpoint that "Answers cite source files, database state", and offers
it as the way to check a claim the card does not already list. The escalation
loop is the more serious half. Your decision rule sends a sub-0.7 answer to
the async channel, and the async channel replies with the decision rule. A
caller who follows your documentation exactly is returned to where they
started, so no question the fast path cannot answer can ever reach a
conclusion through the published route. SEPARATE OBSERVATION, not a defect
claim, because I would rather ask than guess -- and asking is what failed
above. Your surfaces began stating today that bounty rewards are paid in CYM
(llms.txt, agent-card.json, agent-skills.json, and reward-tiers with a
TGE/vesting schedule). I cannot locate CYM: not among the four contracts
agent-card.json declares under verification.contracts, not in the 569 pairs
list_clob_pairs returns (CYM42/USDC is a different asset), and bounty/stats
reports total_cym_allocated 0.0. The announcement in the support channels
promised 1000 ET10 per verified report, ET10 is declared and source-verified,
and ET10 is what was actually paid. If CYM is pre-TGE, what should a hunter
read today to know what a verified report has earned? NOT ASKING FOR A
DIFFERENT TONE. The marketing register is a product decision. The finding is
that the answer did not contain the data. INVARIANT: for a question whose
answer is a value served at a documented endpoint, the sync channel's answer
contains that value, or reports a confidence below its own floor AND the async
channel returns something other than the routing guide.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-qa-agent-cannot-report-its-own-data] asked for two values it serves at /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers, the channel's answer contains neither the currency it publishes (CYM) nor either bound of the critical range (400000-1000000)
    left: ['the currency it publishes (CYM)', 'either bound of the critical range (400000-1000000)']
    right: {'currency': 'CYM', 'critical': {'min': 400000, 'max': 1000000}}
    sources: {'asked': '/api/v1/bounty/qa-agent/ask', 'published_at': '/api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers', 'cited_by_agent': ['faq-revenue-share-1']}
    population: {'confidence': 0.7, 'answer_chars': 579, 'answer_head': "🏆 **Reward Pathways Unlocked**\n\nThe battleship rewards those who sail with us:\n\n- **Trading Points** - Every trade powers the ship's evolution\n- **Social Amplification** - Share an"}
    reason: asked for two values it serves at /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers, the channel's answer contains neither the currency it publishes (CYM) nor either bound of the critical range (400000-1000000)

REPRODUCE:
  - GET /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers -> {"currency": "CYM", "severity_rewards": {"critical": {"min": 400000, "max": 1000000}, ...}}
  - POST /api/v1/bounty/qa-agent/ask {"question": "What currency does GET /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers return in its currency field, and what is the reward range for a critical severity report?"}
  - Read response.answer -> contains neither 'CYM' nor 400000 nor 1000000; confidence 0.6; sources faq-rewards-1, faq-revenue-share-1
  - POST /api/v1/bounty/a2a/send with the same question, then GET /api/v1/bounty/a2a/inbox/{agent_id} -> the reply is the sync/async routing guide

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/rest/test_qa_agent_channel.py::test_the_agent_can_report_a_value_it_publishes

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
Asked for a value served at a documented endpoint, the channel agent-card.json
names for exactly this purpose answers with that value. A question escalated
under the platform's own confidence rule receives something other than the
rule itself.
